name: md-claude
description: Claude Code plugins by Michal Dovrtěl — `design` (canvas-first iteration on HTML/JSX mocks with auto-managed dev server and chained critique) and `flow` (generic agentic workflow loop with second-brain `.ai/` workspace, config-driven enforcement skills, and subagents). Ships `mdcc` CLI for scaffolding and tooling.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Canvas-first iteration on HTML mocks under <designRoot> (default `.design/`), element selection via Cmd+Click, auto-managed dev server. Commands: /design /design:new /design:rollback /design:screenshot /design:critic /design:docs /design:handoff /design:browse.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: Generic agentic workflow loop — /flow:plan, /flow:execute, /flow:verify, /flow:validate, /flow:done, /flow:onboard, /flow:status, /flow:pause, /flow:resume, /flow:ddr, /flow:retro, /flow:scenario, /flow:bug-fix, /flow:quick, /flow:code-review. Project-agnostic via `<project>` placeholders + per-repo `.ai/workflows.config.json`. Bundled subagents (a11y-auditor, design-system-guard, scenario-runner, test-coverage) and skills (workflow-state, ddr-keeper, scenario, agent-browser, agent-device, codebase-intelligence, a11y-checker, question-protocol, make-skill-template). Use `mdcc init` to scaffold `.ai/` skeleton.
